slides.title:
Five layers
of you
slides.subtitle:
An old map of a person, found
one layer at a time by the sage Bhrigu

slides.label: The Taittiriya Upanishad
slides.title: Bhrigu’s question
body: Bhrigu asked his father to teach him what is real

“Find what everything is born from,
lives by and returns to,” his father said

Each time Bhrigu came back,
he had found a deeper layer

slides.label: What he found
slides.title: Five layers
slides.note: Later teachers called them koshas: sheaths, one inside the next

slides.label: In your chart
slides.title: Who looks after each layer

items.label: Food · the body
items.head: Ascendant
items.line: The sign rising when you were born

slides.note: Sutram’s teaching map, built from classical meanings

slides.label: In real life
slides.title: Find the layer
items: Start with the body: sleep, food, a walk
The breath layer: morning light, movement
The mind layer: a routine, a call home

slides.label: Taittiriya Upanishad
slides.quote:
From joy all beings are born,
by joy they live,
into joy they return
body: Bhrigu’s last answer: joy sits under everything
In your chart, Venus and Jupiter show where you find it
